title: Panel manifest (contract v1)
description: The shape of a panel.json. Frozen at v1: both Radium and ClaudeDesktopClient validate against this same file, so a panel folder that satisfies it loads in either host. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-03-panel-contract-v1.md.

contract.description: Contract version this manifest is written against. A host that does not know the version refuses the panel rather than guessing.

id.description: Stable identifier, and the folder name. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; 3-40 characters; no leading or trailing dash.

name.description: Shown in the panel's header and in the add-panel list.

entry.description: Entry HTML file, relative to the panel folder. Must not escape it.

permissions.description: What the panel is asking for. Anything not listed is unreachable: the host's bridge rejects undeclared methods and names the missing permission. Core permissions are portable across hosts; a `vendor:name` permission is host-specific and a host that does not recognise it refuses to install the panel rather than silently dropping the capability.

mcpServers.description: Server ids this panel may reach through `mcp.read` / `mcp.call`. Required when either is requested; an empty list grants nothing. The host never widens this at runtime.

defaultSize.description: Opening size in board grid units.

allOf.description: Asking for MCP access without naming any server is a mistake, not a grant of everything.
